::: {.section #mission}
## Our Mission

:::: {.container}
::::: {.grid-container .grid-2}
:::::: {.card}
### Innovation First
We believe in pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI and developer tools. Our platform enables creators to build applications that think, learn, and adapt.
::::::

:::::: {.card}
### Developer Experience
Great tools should feel invisible. We obsess over every detail of the developer experience, from intuitive APIs to comprehensive documentation.
::::::

:::::: {.card}
### Open Collaboration
The best ideas come from diverse perspectives. We're building a community where developers can share, learn, and create together.
::::::

:::::: {.card}
### Ethical AI
With great power comes great responsibility. We're committed to building AI systems that are transparent, fair, and beneficial to all.
::::::
:::::
::::
:::

::: {.section #values}
## Our Values

:::: {.container}
::::: {.grid-container .grid-3}
:::::: {.value-card}

### Speed
Move fast and iterate. We ship early and often, learning from real-world usage.
::::::

:::::: {.value-card}
::: {.icon}
🎯
:::
### Focus
Do fewer things better. We concentrate on what matters most to developers.
::::::

:::::: {.value-card}
::: {.icon}
✨
:::
### Quality
Excellence in every line of code. We don't compromise on the fundamentals.
::::::

:::::: {.value-card}
::: {.icon}
🤝
:::
### Trust
Be reliable and transparent. We earn trust through consistent delivery.
::::::

:::::: {.value-card}
::: {.icon}
🌍
:::
### Impact
Make a difference. We measure success by the value we create for developers.
::::::

:::::: {.value-card}
::: {.icon}
🎨

### Creativity
Think differently. We encourage unconventional approaches to solving problems.
